title: Canadian Turmeric Flatbread with Vibrant Roasted Vegetables
description: A flavorful and colorful flatbread dish, topped with roasted vegetables and infused with turmeric for added depth.

ingredients.name: vibrant
ingredients.amount: 1 cup mixed roasted vegetables (such as bell peppers, zucchini, and onions)

instructions: Brush the flatbread with olive oil and sprinkle with turmeric.
Top the flatbread with roasted vegetables and crumbled feta cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and sprinkle with chopped bread.
Season with salt to taste and serve immediately.
